name: m2_four_family_screen_v1
multiple_testing: BH across exactly three new primary tests; BP is an already observed reference
screen_rule: coverage >=0.70 in each year, mean RankIC >=0.01, positive RankIC in each year, BH q<=0.10; pass means IC_SCREEN_PASS only, never KEEP or independent alpha
conditional_rule: Reuse exact 2015-fitted 20-PC map and joint industry/size OLS; matched candidate and residual use identical rows; diagnostic only
scope: Historical IC screening and conditional diagnostics only. Net portfolio increments and rolling LightGBM still required. No 2021+ access.
